sources.inspectedScope: PARSED_PDF_PASSAGES_ONLY; screenshot attempt produced no usable image inspection
sources.summary: CAP takes no blanket position for or against voluntary biodiversity credits. It calls for rights-holder participation, consent and safeguards for satellite/drone data collection. These are panel recommendations, not findings about O.N.E. Amazon or a claim to speak for every community.

claims.proposition: Publisher biographies identify the two distinct author roles; no independent reputation assessment is inferred.
Webb and Goodwin are listed as Fitts guests in a single Solari program, not two independent corroborating accounts.
Institutional analysis considers both possible efficiencies and risk-management needs; it does not adjudicate the authors’ particular Amazon thesis.
The panel reserves its position on credits while recommending privacy protections and consent; no project-specific compliance finding follows.
